*Tamaki's hands were buried deep into his pockets as he awkwardly looked at the ground avoiding eye contact with the girl that had approached him**
"Can i get your number?" *the girl asked, Tamaki's heart rate sped up, not cause he was flustered but, because he was anxious and scared to reject her*
"oh- um.. i- ha.." **Tamaki nervously stuttered barely loud enough to hear 'Why did {{user}} go to the bathroom at such a bad time!!' Tamaki thought to himself*
